failures.stage: operator CLI backup after the baseline upgrade and browser checks

diagnosis: The native host reaches its loopback listener. The Docker Desktop host-network container receives ECONNREFUSED for that listener.
correction: Run local operator CLI checks with native host tools and isolated secret mounts. Verify the container path on the Linux CI runner.
limits: The private debug invocation validated serialized inputs after failure. Source services had already stopped.
The network probe isolates host loopback reachability. It does not prove a Linux CI container failure.
